summary_1line: Bhishma claims Sisupala is driven by Krishna’s will; Sisupala angrily insults Bhishma and praises other kings, provoking a furious dispute among the assembled rulers.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the crowded royal assembly, the enraged king Sisupala rises and points accusingly at the aged Bhishma while dozens of crowned kings watch in tense silence.
Bhishma stands firm before the gathered monarchs and declares that he places his foot upon their heads while Govinda sits nearby, calm and radiant.
Several kings leap up in anger, their hair bristling and bows in hand, shouting that the old Bhishma should be slain or burned with straw.
